subject: MAP: POC environment orchestration — org setup, API keys, allowlist & VPC peering
messages:
From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@novamed.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: IT Ops <itops@novamed.com>, legal@novamed.com
Date: Mon, 06 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: POC environment for NovaMed integration

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks for the quick follow-up after the demo. We're ready to get the POC environment in MAP so our devs can run the integration tests. High-level asks from our side:

- Org setup: invite NovaMed dev org and one admin.
- API keys: we'd prefer scoped keys (read-only + test write) with expiration.
- IP allowlist: our network team needs the lists to configure firewall rules.
- VPC peering: we'll need the peering requirements and a short maintenance window.

Attaching our simple network inventory (network-specs.pdf) to speed things up.

Can we aim for a working environment in the week of Jun 21 so we can begin canary tests Jun 22? Also please share a MAP outline with milestones and owner names.

Thanks,

Sophie Martin
Head of Integrations | NovaMed Health
-----
Attachments: network-specs.pdf (1 page)
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Jun 2027 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: POC environment for NovaMed integration

Sophie — thanks, this is great detail. I sketched a short MAP + technical checklist below to make the kickoff concrete. I copied Marissa (AE) to coordinate commercial milestones and Karthik for infra prerequisites.

MAP: POC Environment Orchestration (owner -> Redwood / NovaMed)
- Step 1 (Day 0-1): Org invites — Redwood sends org invite; NovaMed confirms admin account (owner: Nikhil / Sophie).
- Step 2 (Day 1-3): Security attestation & scoping — exchange minimal security questionnaire; legal loop if required (owner: NovaMed legal + Redwood security).
- Step 3 (Day 3-5): API key issuance — create scoped test keys, TTL 30 days, rotate plan documented (owner: Redwood: Nikhil).
- Step 4 (Day 3-7): Network allowlist & peering — NovaMed provides CIDR/IP ranges; Redwood provides peering info and test port list (owner: Karthik / NovaMed IT).
- Step 5 (Day 7-10): Canary test window & validation — run sample inference calls and perf checks; share logs and cost snapshot (owner: NovaMed devs + Redwood SRE).

Immediate asks for your team so we can start Step 2/3 in parallel:
1) Confirm the admin email that should be added to the Redwood org.
2) Provide the list of IPs/CIDRs to allowlist (we need both control-plane and egress ranges).
3) Point of contact for your cloud team for VPC peering and desired maintenance window.

I'll attach a short MAP template (rdw-map-template.xlsx) and our network spec (network-specs.pdf) — please fill the MAP template with dates and owners where possible.

If the timeline you proposed (canary Jun 22) is critical, we should confirm org invite + IP allowlist this week so Karthik can raise peering tickets early.

Best,

Nikhil Sharma
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0123
-----
Attachments: rdw-map-template.xlsx (Excel MAP template)
